title: Aéro: speedrun labyrinthe
description:
Aéro Speedrun Labyrinthe is a third-person puzzle, exploration, platforming and speedrunning game set inside a vast experimental complex that now extends far beyond the original laboratory.

Play as Aéro, a test subject caught at the heart of a strange experiment, accompanied by Aves, a robotic companion who observes and comments on your progress.

Your goal is to make your way through the different laboratory trials, solve puzzles, master the movement mechanics and improve your best times. As the adventure progresses, however, the experiment expands into new environments, larger areas, outer space and even an entire planet.

Run, jump, use your surroundings, activate mechanisms, manipulate objects, find your way through the different facilities and uncover the secrets hidden throughout each area. Some challenges require precision and speed, while others focus more on observation, exploration and logic.

The game currently includes:

• A campaign combining puzzles, platforming, exploration and speedrunning

• 6 biomes with varied environments

• An explorable planet

• Open areas alongside the experimental rooms

• More than 30 hidden bonus eggs to discover

• Challenges based on movement, timing and puzzle-solving

• Spaceship gameplay and travel sequences

• Online multiplayer

• The Golden Egg multiplayer mini-game

• Combat both on foot and in spaceships

• A best-time system designed to encourage replayability

• Fully voiced dialogue

• Text and dialogue available in French and English

• Keyboard/mouse and controller support

• Original cinematics and a science-fiction atmosphere

• Regular updates adding new content, features, improvements and fixes

In the Golden Egg mini-game, a Golden Egg randomly appears in one of the game's biomes. Players must find it, defend it and bring it back to its starting point. If the player carrying the egg is eliminated, possession of the egg passes to their opponent.

Aéro Speedrun Labyrinthe is designed as an evolving experience: learn the environments, master the mechanics, improve your times, explore new areas and discover new secrets added through future updates.

The game continues to evolve regularly, in both solo and multiplayer.
description_short: A third-person speedrun puzzle game set in a mysterious sci-fi laboratory. Complete experimental rooms, master your route, improve your best time, follow Aves’ voiced guidance, and search for the 12 hidden bonus eggs.
